terraform-schema-path-review.txt.text:
Source approval withheld: three concrete grammar/filter defects reproduced in memory on Ubuntu.

- **P1 — Repeated qualifiers hard-constrain alternatives.** `port under alpha.beta or under gamma.delta` filters exclusively to `alpha.beta`; replacing `or` with `and` requires both paths and returns `none`. Comma-separated `under alpha.beta, or gamma.delta` also constrains to the first path. The suffix guard only recognizes a bare dotted identifier immediately after the conjunction. [ranking.ts:183](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:183)

- **P1 — Unrelated negation or disjunction erases affirmative scope.** `No rewrite is needed. Which field sets port under alpha.missing?` extracts no path, retrieves unrelated fields, and can select a leaf. Sentence periods do not reset the clause. Likewise, `port or timeout under alpha.missing` loses the explicit scope because any preceding `or` suppresses it. [ranking.ts:177](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:177)

- **P2 — Unsupported path tokens silently truncate.** `under alpha.beta.1missing` and `under alpha.beta-missing` both extract `alpha.beta` and select its port. The regex accepts a valid prefix without checking the end of the supplied path token. [ranking.ts:167](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:167)

Contiguous segment matching, nested prefixes at segment boundaries, and caller provider/facet/node AND filters are retained. Added tests miss these grammar cases. `git diff --check` passed; the reported 318 focused passes were not rerun. No edits, subagents, GitHub operations, or benchmark authoring. This is source review, not qualification.

terraform-schema-path-rereview.txt.text:
Two concrete findings prevent source approval:

- **P1 — Ignored paths still hard-constrain underscore identifiers.** `port under alpha_one.beta_two or under gamma_three.delta_four` produces no explicit path constraint, but the existing identifier filters AND all four segments, returning `none`. Likewise, `port not under alpha_one.beta_two` still constrains those identifiers and selects that branch. Affects [indexed SQL](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-index.ts:218) and [selection](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-selection.ts:74).

- **P2 — Multiple explicit paths can still select a single leaf.** With matching `alpha.beta.port` and `gamma.delta.port` candidates scored 100/30, both `port under alpha.beta or under gamma.delta` and the `and` variant return `leaf`, not ordinary `choices`. The parser drops the constraint, but [branch-context selection](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-selection.ts:350) treats the alternative mentions as affirmative evidence.

Reproduced through read-only, in-memory source calls. Added tests miss these cases: alternatives are tested only for index result count, using segments without underscores. No edits or qualification performed.

terraform-schema-path-intent-review.txt.text:
Two concrete regressions remain:

- **P1 — Bare underscore alternatives still hard-filter.** [ranking.ts:169](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:169) extracts only qualifier-prefixed mentions. For `port under alpha_one.beta_two or gamma_three.delta_four`, the second path becomes required identifiers. Reproduced selection returns only the gamma destination; indexed SQL likewise requires its segments. Comma-and variants also fail. Added tests cover repeated qualifiers only.

- **P2 — Trailing-dot trimming accepts malformed quoted paths.** [ranking.ts:198](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:198) removes the final dot regardless of sentence position. Reproduced `Which field sets port under `alpha.beta.`?` resolves to a leaf under `alpha.beta`, rather than rejecting the unsupported literal path.

Read-only source review with in-memory reproductions; no edits or qualification claim. Source approval withheld pending these repairs.

terraform-schema-path-final-review.txt.text:
Four concrete regressions remain:

- **P2 — Bare conjunction paths become mandatory.** `port or alpha.beta` returns required path `alpha.beta`, hard-filtering SQL and selection despite alternative intent. `or`/`and` need mention extraction without affirmative scope. [ranking.ts:179](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:179)

- **P2 — Repeated identical alternatives still constrain.** Both `port under alpha.beta or alpha.beta` and `port under alpha.beta and under alpha.beta` return required `alpha.beta`. Deduplication hides multiple mentions, and the final mention survives suffix checking. [ranking.ts:182](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:182)

- **P2 — Alternative/negative choices bypass contradiction filters.** Adding `not under alpha.beta` to `outside IPv4 address` returns choices containing `outside.ipv6.addr` and `inside.ipv4.addr`. The early return skips ordinary selection exclusions. [selection.ts:88](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-selection.ts:88)

- **P2 — Dot trimming is not restricted to sentence endings.** `port under alpha.beta., with TLS enabled` becomes required `alpha.beta`, accepting a malformed ending. [ranking.ts:200](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:200)

Confirmed with read-only calls to current source. Added tests omit these cases. No edits, subagents, GitHub activity, or benchmark authoring; no qualification claim. Source approval withheld.

terraform-schema-boundary-review.txt.text:
Two concrete regressions remain:

- **P2 — Sentence-final period before another sentence rejects valid scope.** [ranking.ts:171](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:171) trims only before `!`, `?`, or end of input. `Port under alpha.beta. Use TLS.` captures `alpha.beta.` as mandatory, so indexed SQL and selection reject `alpha.beta.port`.

- **P2 — Mention removal erases unrelated identifier requirements.** [ranking.ts:200](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/xcsh-4682-postmerge-qualification/packages/coding-agent/src/internal-urls/terraform-property-ranking.ts:200) uses unrestricted `replaceAll`. For `set field alpha_one.beta_two_extra, not under alpha_one.beta_two`, it removes the prefix from the separate field reference too, leaving `_extra` and losing the mandatory `beta_two_extra` identifier. Both index and selection can consequently admit unrelated fields. Remove captured mention spans instead.

The added tests don’t cover these cases. Read-only source review completed; no tests run, edits, subagents, or GitHub access. Source approval withheld; qualification was not assessed.
